overview: The Medford City Council addressed resolutions concerning Amazon labor standards, Cannabis Advisory Committee implementation, and crosswalk safety, and approved several Community Preservation Act funding requests and common victualler licenses. Action on a $300,000 CPA request for Thomas Brooks Park was tabled pending review by the Parks Commission and a city solicitor opinion.

items.title: Deadline Discount Program Discussion
items.summary: Tabled at the request of the sponsor to await additional information.

items.title: Resolution Urging Fair Employment Opportunity at Amazon
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging Amazon to confer with local labor representatives and neighborhood groups to ensure direct employment, living wages, and safety standards before expanding delivery operations in Medford.

items.title: Winthrop Street Crosswalk Repainting and Sign Removal
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting DPW repaint crosswalks on Winthrop Street, amended to request the removal or relocation of obsolete traffic signs at South Street.

items.title: Condolences for Tom Fahey
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences to the family of former Registrar of Voters and community volunteer Tom Fahey.

items.title: Cannabis Advisory Committee Update Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting members of the Cannabis Advisory Committee present their application criteria and scoring system at the next council meeting, alongside a legal opinion on city liability for delayed implementation.

items.title: Overnight Commercial Parking Permit Feasibility
items.summary: Withdrawn by the sponsor following discussion regarding council jurisdiction over parking policy.

items.title: Common Victualler License: Deep Cuts Deli
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Deep Cuts Deli to operate at 572 High Street.

items.title: Common Victualler License: Medford VFW Post 112
items.summary: Tabled at the request of the petitioner.

items.title: Common Victualler License: Work Hard, Eat Good
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Work Hard, Eat Good, an online meal delivery service operating at 114 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Funding Allocations
items.summary: Approved CPA appropriations for Gillis Park ($100,000), Carr Park ($100,000), ABCD move-in assistance ($60,000), and Housing Families Inc ($10,000), while tabling a $300,000 allocation for Thomas Brooks Park phase one pending Parks Commission review and a legal opinion.
